messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the manual of the nanoScan3 safety laser scanner, at what minimum frequency must the regular thorough checks of the protective device be carried out?

response.text: Secondo il manuale dello scanner laser di sicurezza nanoScan3, con quale frequenza minima devono essere effettuati i controlli regolari approfonditi del dispositivo di protezione?
